name: Elhoussaine Ahabchane
headline: I build web apps for Moroccan businesses, from the database to the UI.
about: I'm a full-stack developer from Khénifra, Morocco. I build web
apps with Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS and Node.js, from
Lately I've been working on real products, not tutorials.
I like to start from the actual problem a business has, then
pick the simplest solution that holds up.
